covers.name: email-builder-settings
covers.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original portfolio case cover, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, highest practical crisp resolution.
Visual direction: premium tangible studio product photography/realistic CGI with exact flat application UI on the surfaces, tactile charcoal and graphite setting, restrained slate shadows, soft realistic side light, sharp readable interface forms, white and pale gray UI with teal #009f88 accents from the references, extremely restrained muted lime environmental reflection if any. Stylish, quietly sophisticated, polished professional product designer portfolio. Generous composition with complete important content inside a 5% safe margin.
The provided images are interface-content references only, never a composition to duplicate. Create a genuinely NEW cover image expressing the whole case. Extract the visual logic and actual controls from the references, then arrange them coherently in the new scene. Keep the UI faithful, no invented analytics or business metrics. Screens must have crisp typography and clean straight edges. Use only a few short Russian labels where readable and keep tiny UI text understated. No huge headline, caption, decorative text, added branding, logos, watermarks, Figma canvas, prototype wires, spaghetti connections, rainbow glow, cartoon illustration, gaming aesthetic, clutter, hands or people in the room. The image must itself be the final cover, without external border or page mockup.
Primary request: a beautiful slim graphite desktop monitor on a dark slate studio plinth, almost front-on but turned slightly to the left, large and centred. The full screen shows a coherent email editor: a compact top toolbar, a slim block/navigation rail at left, a large white product-email canvas in the middle, and an organized settings sidebar at right. Use the white/teal product UI and field styling from both references. Email canvas has two restrained product cards with clean charcoal/cream apparel photos, product labels and black purchase buttons. A selected nested product element has one fine teal outline and the right sidebar clearly shows its settings divided into tidy pale-gray groups: "Продукты", "Фон блока", "Отступы и выравнивание", "Скругления". A SINGLE enlarged floating settings panel overlaps the monitor's lower-right edge, repeating a compact set of the same controls with clean numerical inputs, alignment buttons and one teal slider. This represents scattered settings becoming one coherent system and direct access to nested elements. Keep the monitor stand visible and one convincing long soft shadow; monitor and floating panel occupy roughly 80 percent of the composition. Do not copy the browser image, do not show annotated spacing marks, do not show any red scribbles or measurements.
